performance.verdict: Google zero-conversion leak confirmed; Meta CPL rising; 5 SOW blockers unresolved.

findings.text: CPL rose 30.17% in 7d; 28-day blended CPL $16.49 with Meta carrying all 133 leads and Google delivering 0 conversions from $501.02 spent.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL gap closure, end-to-end stack re-test ⛔, paid landing pages, UGC batch — all unverified as of 2026-08-31.
3-day lead signal (Sep 14–16): 4/8/4 = avg 5.3/day vs prior 3-day (Sep 11–13): 4/0/0 = avg 1.3/day — partial recovery, but meta_spend also recovered to ~$84–86/day, so no efficiency gain.
Google Ads: 0 conversions across 28 days and 109 clicks at $501.02 spend — likely client-side pixel not firing, not campaign failure, but money is unattributed either way.
GHL shows 154 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days against 133 leads — intake is logging contacts but pipeline is not converting, suggesting a CRM workflow or follow-up gap.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion tracking: pixel is returning 0 conversions on 109 clicks and $501.02 spend — verify client-side tag firing before next spend cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has produced 0 conversions from 109 clicks and $501.02 in the 28-day window — the probable cause is a broken or unfired client-side conversion pixel. Audit the tag in GTM or the Google Ads tag directly and confirm a test conversion fires. Success is at least one verified conversion event in Google Ads within 3 days (by 2026-09-20). Until confirmed working, no budget should be added to Google Ads.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL pipeline: 154 opps created, 0 appointments, 0 won in 28 days — audit follow-up automation and appointment booking steps for workflow errors.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 154 opportunities created against 133 Meta leads with 0 appointments and 0 closed-won in the 28-day window. This is an intake or automation gap, not an ads problem. Audit the post-lead follow-up sequence and appointment booking trigger in GHL to confirm leads are receiving outreach. Success is at least 1 booked appointment confirmed in GHL within 7 days (by 2026-09-24).

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL: 30.17% rise in 7d with 3-day partial recovery to 5.3 leads/day — hold budget, re-check on Sep 20 before any scale decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL rose 30.17% over the last 7 days. The 3-day signal (Sep 14–16) shows leads recovering to avg 5.3/day but spend also recovered proportionally, so no efficiency gain is yet confirmed. Hold Meta daily budget at current levels (~$84–86/day). Re-check on 2026-09-20: if CPL has returned toward the prior 7-day baseline without a proportional spend increase, a scale step of up to +15% is defensible.
